title: Agent Network
style: A system map: agents are nodes (circles with a small glyph and a mono label) on a dark ground; dotted edges draw between them; messages travel along edges as small glowing packets; thin orbit ellipses spin around the busiest node; a log panel prints each handoff in mono. Captions are serif word ladders (kit captions.ts): short stacks of mixed sizes, one key word in the accent italic, set beside the action and arriving word by word.
learnsFrom: Founder explainer reels (Instagram, @gregisenberg's team): a node diagram with dotted connections and orbit ellipses around a hub, handoffs between agents, a dark square with a starburst of connections.

story.what: hook: one node blinks on, labelled 'request: one hour, four people'
four agent nodes appear (Calendar, People, Rooms, Notes) and dotted edges draw to the hub
packets travel: hub → Calendar → People (conflict!) → Calendar; the log prints each handoff
orbit ellipses spin up around the hub as it resolves; one packet turns yellow: 'Thu 15:00'
all nodes flash green in sequence; the log prints 'booked · 4/4 accepted'
sign-off: the network collapses into a single node that becomes 'Oriel'

sizes: Vertical stacks the network in the upper two thirds and the log panel below.
sound: beatScore soft at 120 bpm with a blip for every packet hop, a hit when the time resolves and the sign-off.
teaches: A system reads when you show traffic, not boxes: let packets move along the edges and log every handoff.

portable.fonts: JetBrains Mono for labels and the log, Instrument Serif and Instrument Serif Italic for captions
